enabled.description: Enable or disable the mDNS reflector service entirely.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (by name) between which mDNS traffic should be reflected. Each interface must be a Layer 2 segment (e.g., VLAN, bridge, physical).

ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) for reflected mDNS packets. Controls how far (in hops) reflected packets propagate. Higher = wider reach but more network load.

rate_limit.description: Maximum mDNS packets per second allowed per interface. Helps prevent network flooding during discovery storms.

bidirectional.description: If true, mDNS queries and responses are reflected in both directions. If false, only inbound responses are reflected (less overhead, limited discovery).

run_user.description: Unix user to run the mDNS reflector daemon as (e.g., 'nobody'). Leave empty for default.

run_group.description: Unix group to run the mDNS reflector daemon as (e.g., 'nogroup'). Leave empty for default.

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments for the mDNS reflector daemon (e.g., '-v' for verbose logs, '--no-ipv6' to disable IPv6 support).
